page.notes: The scan is a cut, low-contrast photograph; the Latin is set in small type and several figures are read with doubt, notably the reference after "inter Christianos veros qui non" ("cen-fendi" is a line break, "[?]" marks the uncertain word "censendi"), and "Christiani cur sancti ab Apostolo appellati 208", whose final figure is cut off by the page edge. The signature "β 4" and the reference "213 b" are at the bottom right and may be read as one line. Some entries of the right column ("Christianorum vti omnia", "Christianorum quorunda error") are uncertain; the u/v spelling has been normalised as instructed. Left and middle column entries with "Cenaan" and "Cedrus" are read as printed.
